title: Derived etale cohomology over an inverse limit
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $(Y_i)_{i\in I}$ be a cofiltered inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated $T$-schemes with affine transition maps and limit $Y$, and let $K\in D^+(\Ab(T_{\Et}))$ [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] be a bounded-below complex of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Write $K_i$ and $K_Y$ for its inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] on $Y_i$ and $Y$. Then the pullback maps induce, for every integer $n$, an isomorphism

$$
 \varinjlim_i H^n(Y_{i,\Et},K_i)\xrightarrow{\sim} H^n(Y_{\Et},K_Y),
$$

where cohomology of a complex is the cohomology of derived global sections [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. No torsion or fixed finite coefficient-ring hypothesis is required.
